mutants.name: chk1b-cache-producer-not-shared
mutants.rule: Emission reuses the producer acquired for checked std instead of acquiring it again.

mutants.name: e5-receipt-last-wins
mutants.rule: Recursive receipts retain every package, including an earlier refutation. The CLI subprocess is not instrumented by the package's coverage pass.

mutants.name: rcpt-reset-per-run
mutants.rule: An explored worker runs the tests once per schedule in one process; each run's receipt holds each law run once, equal to a plain run's. The CLI subprocess is not instrumented by the package's coverage pass.

mutants.name: e5-receipt-main-identity
mutants.rule: Receipt identity is the loaded module path, not the checker's program-entry identity main. The CLI subprocess is not instrumented by the package's coverage pass.

mutants.name: e5-law-every-package
mutants.rule: A recursive law selection runs only packages whose checked run list contains the title. The CLI subprocess is not instrumented by the package's coverage pass.

mutants.name: x6-worker-inherits-collector
mutants.rule: Explored and plain test-program children share the bounded collector policy.

mutants.name: e5-fatal
mutants.rule: A defect keeps status 2 and stops later packages, rather than becoming an ordinary failed law.

mutants.name: e5-empty
mutants.rule: An empty recursive selection is an error, never a green run with nothing tested.

mutants.name: e5-pattern
mutants.rule: check and test accept a recursive package pattern.

mutants.name: e5-roots
mutants.rule: Every selected package, not just the first root, runs.

mutants.name: e5-order
mutants.rule: Dependencies run before their dependents, independent of folder name order.

mutants.name: e5-status
mutants.rule: One failed law makes the module command exit 1.

mutants.name: e5-continue
mutants.rule: A failed law does not hide the tests of later packages.

mutants.name: e5-nested
mutants.rule: A nested module is outside the selected module.

mutants.name: e5-fmt
mutants.rule: fmt accepts the same recursive module pattern without checking types.

mutants.name: dist1h-requires-all-platforms
mutants.rule: An old binding is still admitted on each platform its header states.

mutants.name: dist1h-missing-platforms-admitted
mutants.rule: A binding with no platform provenance fails closed.

mutants.name: dist1h-substring-platform-admitted
mutants.rule: A platform is a complete header token, never a substring.

mutants.name: dist1h-wrong-binding-header-admitted
mutants.rule: A binding's platform header must name its imported package.

mutants.name: b15-r8-test-inherits-gogc
mutants.rule: Bounded test programs do not inherit a disabled or enlarged GC target.

mutants.name: b15-r8-test-inherits-soft-limit
mutants.rule: The child's soft heap limit is below its hard data cap.

mutants.name: b15-r8-test-overrides-explicit-off
mutants.rule: An explicitly unbounded test program retains the caller's collector settings.

mutants.name: b15-r7-go-context-mask-ignored
mutants.rule: A completed release observes a masked, non-cancellable Go context.

mutants.name: b16a-receipt-omits-searched-law
mutants.origin: wf10 batch-16a integration (L10 receipts x X1 machine laws)
mutants.from: b.WriteString("\t\t" + l.helper("RecordSearch") + "(" + strconv.Quote(label) + ", " + held + ", " + how + ", " + where + ")\n\t}\n")
mutants.rule: runtime.md Tests 8: the law receipt has one entry per law run, a machine's searched reachability law included.

mutants.name: c3-api-route-removed
mutants.rule: The public inspect api command reaches its checked projection.

mutants.name: r3b-spell
mutants.rule: ergo gen rpc names the contract by its resolved import path, never by how the command spelled the folder; --check from any spelling finds current files current.

mutants.name: dist1-platform-unchecked
mutants.rule: A platform outside the target list is the EF110 refusal, however it was named.

mutants.name: dist1-platform-flag-on-run
mutants.rule: --platform belongs to build: run and test execute what they link, so they link for the host's platform.

mutants.name: dist1-environment-ignored
mutants.rule: Without --platform, GOOS and GOARCH of the environment choose the platform, as for go build.

mutants.name: dist1-action-ignores-platform
mutants.rule: The Go action links for the platform the options name.

mutants.name: dist1-cgo-left-to-the-host
mutants.rule: Every Ergo link is cgo-free: the bindings are typed with CGO_ENABLED=0, and a cross link has no C toolchain.

mutants.name: dist1-runtime-kqueue-arm64-only
mutants.rule: The runtime links on every platform of the target list (a build-tagged runtime file must cover each).

mutants.name: dist1-emission-keyed-on-platform
mutants.rule: The emitted module is platform-independent: one module serves every platform's link.

mutants.name: check-eval-bypassed
mutants.rule: ergo check runs a checked source's pure obligations and reports them (L7); a false example is not checked.

mutants.name: check-host-fallback
mutants.rule: ergo check never falls back to a Go build or ergo test; a skip or a refutation is reported as such.

mutants.name: rc4b-inspect-engine-missing
mutants.rule: ergo inspect shows each derived type with its parse engine, the reason and the counts (patterns.md, Derivation 7).

mutants.name: b18-home-telemetry-on
mutants.rule: The HOME witness measures Ergo's writes: with Go's telemetry left on, the compile and link the direct build path runs write their counters under the witnessed HOME, which is Go's write, not Ergo's.

mutants.name: test-main-initialized
mutants.rule: ergo test builds and runs no package with nothing to test, so a main package's initializers never run.

mutants.name: empty-receipt-builds
mutants.rule: A package with nothing to test is not built for a receipt either (the fu-test-main gap).

mutants.name: empty-run-names
mutants.rule: The empty run refuses a --run name with the test binary's own usage line.

mutants.name: empty-seed-default
mutants.rule: The empty run's receipt names the seed the test binary would use, 1 when none is given.

mutants.name: empty-law-status
mutants.from:

		return exitStatusError{code: 1, handled: true}
mutants.to:
"error: no law "+opts.law)
		return exitStatusError{code: 2, handled: true}
mutants.rule: A --law name in a package with nothing to test fails with the test binary's status, 1.

mutants.name: cache-args-unkeyed
mutants.rule: A test result is keyed by the binary's arguments: a --run name replays no run of every test.

mutants.name: cache-env-unkeyed
mutants.rule: A test result is keyed by the GO*, CGO_* and ERGO_* variables the go command and the runtime read.

mutants.name: cache-go-unkeyed
mutants.rule: A test result is keyed by the go command that links the binary, so another or a reinstalled Go misses.

mutants.name: cache-count-ignored
mutants.rule: --count 1 always runs, as go test -count=1.

mutants.name: cache-fail-kept
mutants.rule: Only a passing run is cached: a cached verdict is the verdict of a rerun.

mutants.name: cache-hit-links
mutants.rule: A cached test result is found before the link: a warm hit invokes no go command.

mutants.name: cs-warm-key-omits-flag
mutants.rule: The request key holds every option that changes the answer: check with another --seed is another request.
